# FIGAROH

> A Python toolbox for dynamic parameter identification and geometric calibration of robots and humans.

FIGAROH is a Python toolbox for geometric calibration, dynamic parameter identification and optimal experiment design of robots. Runnable robot examples live in the figaroh-examples repository. Agent skills ship in the figaroh repository under skills/.

## Start

- [Quickstart](https://thanhndv212.github.io/figaroh-plus/start/quickstart/index.md)
- [Installation](https://thanhndv212.github.io/figaroh-plus/getting_started/index.md)
